title: Vibrant Smoky Spanish Pork Skewers
description: A cultured and nostalgic Spanish dish featuring palm sugar and char-grill flavors, these pork skewers are perfect for any occasion. The combination of smoky and sweet flavors will transport you to the streets of Spain.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together palm sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice and 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Brush the lemon mixture onto the skewers during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or rosemary.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
